verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a client-side UI framework. It hosts no production environment or data of its own, so a vendor-provided sandbox environment isolated from production data is a category error for this kind of product. The documented testing tools (Vitest, @vue/test-utils, Playwright for E2E) are local test tooling, not a sandbox environment with isolation from production data, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
